notes.title: March Update and Story Mode Conclusion
notes.content:
Version 0.6.8 Change Log
*Ranked Play Season 1 continues!
*1 cost energy gain units nerfed to [1/T]
*Chapter 3 of Story Mode is out now!

Info on Ranked Play Season 1:
During the period of January 10th to April 10th, players may submit their scores to the leader boards. All players who submit a score with at least 15 games or more will gain this seasons exclusive spell book skin. 

More on the nerf:
Units with the following skill "[Auto]:When (condition), gain 1 Life." have been changed to "[Auto][1/T]: When (condition), gain 1 Life". This was to reduce the energy economy of the game, as it has been shown to be too easy for certain archetypes to gain more energy than others. Resulting in vastly over powered Nations. This has been changed to help balance the game.

notes.title: Ranked Play Season 1 Update! (Version 0.6.6)
notes.content:
Version 0.6.6 Change Log
*Visual Improvements
*Ranked Play Season Launch
*New Art Added
*Help menu shortcut added to the main menu

More on Ranked Player Season 1:
During this event, players will get to battle it out on Ranked Play for the title of Ceres World Champion. To participate, all a player will need to do is play 15 games in Ranked Play. Then, submit their score to the Leaderboards.
All Players who submit a score from January 10th to April 10th will receive this season's Spell Book skin!
The player who has the highest score on the leader board at the end of the event will be crowned Ceres World Champion. The world champ will get their winning spell book featured in the sample books list and will have the opportunity to design their very own card! 
Please enjoy the first ranked play event!

notes.title: November Emergency Patch (Version 0.6.5)
notes.content:
Version 0.6.5 Change Log
*Fixed a story mode A.I. glitch
*Nerfed "Nuke" cards. 

Notes on Nuke cards:
The prevalence of instant field resets was not health for this game. The only way to keep resources over multiple turns is to play the to the field. Therefore, having so many ways to instantly wipe those resources out was a poor design call. As such, field nuke cards have been nerfed.

notes.title: Changes to Update Schedule
notes.content:
I have gotten a new job working as a card designer on another project. As such, Card Battle Spirit Link will be a weekend project for me for the foreseeable future. Updates and new content are planned and will be released. However, these updates will only be released every other month, rather than monthly. 
Thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: Version 0.6.2 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.6.2 Change Log:
*Fixed the Tutorial Timer
*Rebalanced <<The Citadel>> nation's <Soldier> cards
*Fixed a glitch that allowed for repeated use of [End] skills by turning extra pages
*Chapter 2 of Story Mode added

Notes on <<The Citadel>> rebalance:
Due to "Humanity's Hope, General Grant" reduction in Start Phase energy, the design of <Soldier> units needed to pivot. Before this update, most <Soldier> units were to expensive to be played in a Grant Spell Book. Most <Soldier> units have had their costs reduced.

notes.title: Version 0.6.1 Update
notes.content:
*Upgraded in game Keyword Display
*Changed [Sneak] to refresh on [Enter]
*New Art
*Added Ranked Play Leader Board

More on Ranked Play Leader Board:
The Ranked Play Leader Board can be viewed from the Play menu in game, or the Steam Community tab in Steam. In the Play menu, a new Button has been added next to the "Settings" button. This button will display the Ranked Play Leader Board and allows uploading of your current Ranked Play score. You may only Upload if you have played at least 15 games. One you upload, your previous score on the Leader Board is overwritten and your current score is re-set. If you upload a score with a win percentage of at least 75%, you will gain 1 random gold card. 

How Score is Calculated: 
Score = (Win Percent * 1000) + total games played. 
This method of score calculations was chosen to make win percent the most important factor, but not exclude total games played. If two players have the same win percentage, the player with more total games will be ranked higher.

notes.title: Version 0.6.0 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.6.0 Change Log:
*Updated menus
*Changed the effects of Bloody Harvest, Lead Singer, Stratos Bloodwalker, and Warehouse Manager, Tance, to be more in line with the original design vision for the cards.
*Re-worked the entire <Idol> Archetype.
*Changed the effect of Inspiring Aura to improve functionality
*Reduced the cost and stats of several <Ninja> Units. Included was "Shinobi Trainee". This was done to give Drahon a real 0 Drop.
*New Art

More on the <Idol> redesign:
After much playtesting, it was decided that <Idol> needed to be redesigned. During the initial design phase, <Idol> had an archetypeal effect '[Cont]:Destroy me at turn end' instead of '[Cont]:Destroy me after my attack'. Due to the initial archetypeal effect, it was necessary to give <Idol> a focus on [Rush]. When the archetypeal effect was changed to what it is now, [Rush] was kept on the cards. This resulted in <Idol>'s downside of self destruction became an upside. With Cecelia being able to instantly resummon the destroyed <Idol>, granting it another attack. Additionally, the [Rush] focused playstyle resulted in <Idol> being a better version of <Gangster>. Therefore, it was necessary to change <Idol> and allow them to occupy their own gameplay space within Card Battle Spirit Link.

notes.title: Version 0.5.8 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.5.8 Change Log:
*Fixed a drop zone display glitch.
*Added a Turn and Energy counters to the deck builder.
*Changed Eternal Idol, Livvy.
*Changed Song of Tranquility.
*Fixed a glitch that would cause endless book burn damage.
*It is no longer possible to turn an extra page after triggering a [Use] skill.

notes.title: Version 0.5.7 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.5.7 Change Log:
*Changed starting life to 20 for the first player, and 23 for the second player.
*Fixed a glitch with "Elder Warlock, Crinsceptus" Leader Power. Previously, the leader power would only activate if there was another Dinosaur in the drop zone after Banishing a card. This has been fixed.
*"President's Determination" now grants +0/+8/+0
*New artwork and visual changes.

More on changes to starting life:
The new starting life amounts (20 and 23) have been implemented in a trial period. This change was made to slightly alter the pace of the game. The goal is to still have fast paced gameplay, yet enable all players to play the game the way they want. Ideally this new life total will let players have more consistent access to their desired combos.

notes.title: Version 0.5.6 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.5.6 Change Log:
*Changed "Battery Fairy" effect
*Major fixes and upgrades to  A.I.
*While hovering over a card in the enemy backrow, it's details will no longer be off screen.
*The attribute <Sealed Fairy> has been changed to <Sealed Faerie>. This change was to prevent confusion between the <Sealed Fairy> attribute and the <Fairy> attribute.

notes.title: Version 0.5.4 Update
notes.content:
Version 0.5.4 Change Log:
*New card art
*Changed the skills of "Maid Leader, Kathryn"
*Fixed the sorting button in the book builder
*Audio improvements
*Reduced the chance of getting duplicate Leaders in Arena Mode
*Added card previews for all cards in the player Drop Zone
*New card border layout
*Increased base stats by 2 for all non-0 cost Units(Explanation below)
*Rewrote card text for consistency and clarity
*Small visual improvements

More on stat changes:
CBSL has a cost/stat relationship as follows: 1 Energy = 4 in ATK/DEF = 2 Damage/Crit. Previously, 0 cost units had a vanilla base line of 1/1/2 and 1 cost units had a vanilla base line of 2/2/2. As such, players were paying 1 energy for a +1/+1 stat increase. This was not consistent with the cost/stat relationship and caused 0 drops to be overvalued. My apologies for this oversight. The issue has been resolved by adding an additional 2 stat points to all non-0 cost Units.

notes.title: Version 0.5.3 Update
notes.content:
Here's what's new in Version 0.5.3
*Added a "News" section.
*Added a "Turn Another Page" option during the start phase of each turn in a Card Battle.
*Small visual improvements

More on Turning Additional Pages. At the start of your turn, before you take any other actions ("While the End Turn button says "Turn Another Page" instead of "End Turn"), you may press the End Turn button. Instead of ending your turn, you will turn a page of your spell book. This feature was added to increase the number of options players have in a Card Battle. This feature should allow battles to be more exciting and varied while still maintaining a high level of planning and skill.
